gloss: home run; big hit; major success

definitions.explanation: A hit in baseball that allows the batter to round all bases and score. One of the most exciting plays in baseball.
Used figuratively to describe a spectacular success or achievement, similar to English 'hitting it out of the park.'

examples.japanese: ホームラン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}った→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
{満塁|まんるい}ホームラン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They came from behind with a grand slam.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{今季|こんき}{三十本|さんじゅっぽん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ホームラン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}って→打つ：01221_utsu⟧{本塁打王|ほんるいだおう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いた→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧。
examples.english: He hit thirty home runs this season and was crowned home run champion.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{企画|きかく}→企画：04879_kikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ホームランだった。
examples.english: That project was a home run.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{新商品|しんしょうひん}→新商品：11504_shinshouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ホームラン⟦{級|きゅう}→級：28171_kyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ヒット→ヒット：11161_hitto⟧だ。
examples.english: This new product is a blockbuster hit.

examples.japanese: ⟦ヒット→ヒット：11161_hitto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}み{重|かさ}ねる→積み重ねる：06235_tsumikasaneru⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{一発|いっぱつ}→一発：08895_ippatsu⟧ホームラン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{狙|ねら}う→狙う：00313_nerau⟧⟦タイプ→タイプ：01534_taipu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経営者|けいえいしゃ}→経営者：16188_keieisha⟧だ。
examples.english: He's the type of businessman who goes for the big win rather than building up small successes.

notes:
A loanword from English, deeply embedded in Japanese culture due to the enormous popularity of baseball in Japan. Also written as ⟦{本塁打|ほんるいだ}→本塁打：24569_honruida⟧ in formal sports writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ホームラン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to hit a home run
- {満塁|まんるい}ホームラン: grand slam
- ⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧ホームラン: come-from-behind home run
- ホームラン⟦{級|きゅう}→級：28171_kyuu⟧: home-run-level (spectacular)
- ⟦{本塁打|ほんるいだ}→本塁打：24569_honruida⟧⟦{王|おう}→王：19353_ou⟧: home run champion

CULTURAL NOTE:
Baseball (⟦{野球|やきゅう}→野球：04727_yakyuu⟧) is Japan's most popular spectator sport. Home run records and home run derbies receive extensive media coverage. The figurative use of ホームラン is very common in business and everyday conversation to describe any outstanding success.
